content: Which agency produced the most in-force policies?

name: query_salesforce

content:
[Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmOAAU/view) produced the most, with **61** in-force policies worth **$1,147,109** in annual premium. That's about 62% of all in-force premium.

| Agency | In-force policies | Annual premium |
|---|---|---|
| [Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmOAAU/view) | 61 | $1,147,109 |
| [Prairie State Insurance Agency](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmNAAU/view) | 39 | $312,598 |
| [Driftless Insurance Group](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmPAAU/view) | 35 | $194,701 |
| No agency listed | 54 | $193,332 |

The 54 policies with no agency listed are probably direct business, but the records don't say.
